header: THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH BENCH AT SUKKUR
Date of hearing Order with signature of Judge
body: 3. For hearing of main case 16.11.2026 Mr. Riaz Hussain Malik, Advocate for the petitioner .-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.- 1. Urgency is granted.
2. Exemption is granted subject to all just legal exceptions.

3. Grievance of the petitioner is that though the accused persons have been declared proclaimed offenders with proceeding under Sections 87 and 88 Cr.P.C., the police is not taking any efforts to arrest them. If that is so, the trial Court has ample powers to pass orders to follow up the arrest of the proclaimed offenders, as noted by this Court in the case of Nasrullah v. Station House Officer, Police Station Jacobabad (PLD 2016 Sindh 238) in following terms:

“Similarly, the cases wherein police submits final report/charge sheet by showing all accused as absconders under Section 512 Cr.P.C., shall not be treated as final report; learned Magistrate shall postpone the cognizance in terms of Section 344 Cr.P.C.; while by treating such report as an interim report, shall fix those cases fortnightly for progress report.” Given the foregoing pronouncement by this Court, the remedy of the petitioner continues to be before the trial Court. The petition is dismissed. JUDGE Naveed Ali
